name: ECDICT
notes: Primary local dictionary source. Build script filters rows whose tag column contains gre.

name: Tatoeba
license: CC BY 2.0 by default; some sentences CC0
notes: Official exports provide complete learner-oriented sentences and translation links. Import script selects one short complete sentence per word when downloads are reachable.

name: Open English WordNet
notes: Open English WordNet is released with JSON downloads and usage examples in synset gloss data. It is a strong candidate for dictionary-derived examples when sentence-corpus examples are unavailable.

name: Wiktionary-derived datasets
license: CC BY-SA / GFDL depending on dump content and derivative dataset
notes: Use only dump-based or clearly licensed parsed datasets. Avoid ad hoc scraping of individual pages.
